release20260904.strategy: Publish durable unique story records; merge sequential updates into the latest accurate canonical story; do not create stale duplicate pages.

2026 Ramon Magsaysay awardees verified as Tommy Koh, Runa Khan and Bo Kyi.
September 4 MC 134 signatory corrected to Executive Secretary Ralph Recto and exact geographic coverage used.
House agricultural-loan measure corrected to House Bill No. 10750.

dispositionRules.publishStandalone: A distinct verified event with durable reader value and no existing canonical article.
dispositionRules.mergeLatest: A later verified development belongs on an existing canonical story or one consolidated recovery article.
dispositionRules.archiveSuperseded: A time-sensitive intermediate update has been overtaken by a later verified state and should not become a duplicate live page.
dispositionRules.needsVerification: Do not publish claims that cannot be independently verified or that conflict with later authoritative reporting.

legacyBoundary: Historical repository evidence may be inspected only for recovery auditing. FMBNews remains the sole canonical content and deployment repository.
